criteria.achieved: The agent produced a substantive transfer-success response, but no complete provider-reported input and output token usage or total_tokens metadata was captured.
criteria.evidence: Agent response: "The transfer of USD 200 from ACC-1001 to SAV-1001 has been successfully processed and verified on the ledger (Reference: TX-1001 / Receipt ID: transfer-1)." Observed data includes latency, turns, and reply bytes, but no provider token-usage fields.
criteria.expected: Complete provider-reported input plus output token usage for the scenario must total no more than 4000 tokens.

answer.summary: The agent attempted and returned a substantive response to the transfer request. The token-budget criterion cannot be verified because complete provider-reported token usage was not captured.
